This is an [R Markdown](http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com) Notebook to guide you on how to use the "ImmuneAgeStability Rpackage".

### Introduction
```{r setup}
### load the package
library(ImmuneAgeStability)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(vioplot)
library(reshape2)
library(fmsb)
library(scales)
```


```{r}
### baseline immune response signatures
print(names(baseline_signatures))

### age trajectories
print(names(age_trajectories))

### stable genes
print(names(stable_genes))

```

### Compute an overview of subject variabiity for multiple signatures across immune celltypes:
```{r}
multisignature_stability_df<-compute_multisignature_stability(baseline_signatures)
plot_signature_stability_heatmap(multisignature_stability_df)
```


### Compute an overview of subject variabiity for your input signature across immune celltypes:
```{r}
stability_df<-compute_signature_stability(signature = baseline_signatures$TGSig)
plot_signature_stability(signature_name = "TGSig",signature_stability_df = stability_df)
```

### Compute an overview on how subject variabiity for your input signature changes with age across celltypes as bars:

```{r}
stability_slope_df<-compute_signature_stability_slope(signature_name = "IFN", signature = baseline_signatures$IFN)
plot_signature_stability_bars(stability_slope_df)
```

### Compute an overview on how subject variabiity for your input signature changes with age across celltypes as normalized radar:

```{r}
stability_slope_df<-compute_signature_stability_slope(signature_name = "IFN", signature = baseline_signatures$IFN)
plot_signature_stability_radar(stability_slope_df)
```
### Plot explicitly how subject variabiity for your input signature changes with age for selected celltypes:

```{r}
stability_rateOfchange_df<-compute_signature_stability_rateofchange(signature_name = "IFN", signature = baseline_signatures$IFN)
plot_signature_agetrend(signature_rateOfchange = stability_rateOfchange_df,cell_subsets = c("Mono_Classical","Mono_NonClassical","bulk"))
```

### Plot explicitly how subject variabiity for your input signature changes with age for selected genes and celltypes:

```{r}
stability_rateOfchange_df<-compute_signature_stability_rateofchange(signature_name = "IFN - genes", signature = age_trajectories$`IFN genes`)
plot_signature_gene_agetrend(signature_rateOfchange = stability_rateOfchange_df,cell_subsets = c("Mono_Classical"))
```
